source_of_predeclaration: V&V programme plan F2 WP2.4; Phase C3 owner decision 2026-10-23 (T2B CONVENTION_REAL_DATA: real data require final EOP or a high-precision Earth PCK covering the data epochs)

survey_before_predeclaration.note: Seen before these gates were written (diagnostic, not a gate): production loads only earth_2025_250826_2125_predict.bpc, coverage 2025-01-01..2125-11-22, last datum 2025-08-26; earth_latest_high_prec.bpc is on disk but not loaded, coverage 2000-01-01..2026-04-19, last datum 2026-01-21. Pre-2025 epochs (all LRO data) have no ITRF93 orientation in production; F1 LRO scripts furnish the high-precision kernel themselves. DSS-14 position, predict vs high-precision: 5e-5 m at 2025-06-01, 5.0 mm at 2025-08-20, 6.19 m at 2025-10-01, 21.4 m at 2026-03-01.
survey_before_predeclaration.limitation: The local high-precision kernel is stale (last datum 2026-01-21, today 2026-11-03). Fetching a newer one is a download and needs the owner's permission; the manifest pins the present file.

scope_slice_1: Earth-orientation profiles in spice_loader, selected like the planetary ephemeris (explicit argument, else LUNAR_OD_EARTH_ORIENTATION, else default): PREDICT (default) furnishes earth_latest_high_prec.bpc immediately BEFORE the predict PCK, so the predict kernel keeps priority wherever it covers and the high-precision kernel only adds pre-2025 coverage; MEASURED furnishes it immediately AFTER the predict PCK, so it has priority over its whole span. station_frames gains earth_orientation_provenance(et) (which loaded Earth PCK supplies body 3000 at et, searched in reverse load order with pckcov; its last datum read from the kernel comment 'UTC Epoch of last datum'; measured = et <= last datum) and require_measured_earth_orientation(et_values) (fail-closed PredictedEarthOrientationError). is_predicted_earth_orientation is re-expressed through the provenance. The high-precision kernel's SHA-256 enters the kernel manifest.
out_of_scope_slice_1: scenario/ingestion wiring of a measured-only policy and run-output provenance (slice 2); IERS EOP file reader; plate motion, pole tide, ocean loading; NAIF DSN station SPK cross-check; downloading newer kernels

G1_default_unchanged_where_predict_cover.rule: PREDICT profile kernel list = previous list with earth_latest_high_prec.bpc inserted immediately before the predict PCK; sxform('ITRF93','J2000') at 30 monthly epochs 2025-01-02..2027-06-02 bitwise equal to the previous kernel list

G2_default_gains_pre_2025_coverage.rule: PREDICT profile resolves ITRF93 at 2000-01-02, 2009-09-20, 2010-09-20, 2015-06-01, 2020-06-01, 2024-12-31, bitwise equal to the high-precision kernel loaded alone (with LSK and the ITRF93 association FK)

G3_measured_profile_priority.rule: MEASURED profile: epochs inside [2000-01-02, 2026-04-18] bitwise equal to the high-precision kernel alone; epochs 2026-04-20..2027-06 bitwise equal to the predict kernel alone

G4_provenance.rule: earth_orientation_provenance reads last datum 2025-08-26T00:00:00 UTC (predict) and 2026-01-21T00:00:00 UTC (high precision) from the comments; kernel and measured flag match: PREDICT 2020-06-01 high_prec/measured, 2025-06-01 predict/measured, 2025-10-01 predict/predicted; MEASURED 2025-10-01 high_prec/measured, 2026-03-01 high_prec/predicted, 2026-06-01 predict/predicted; 1990-01-01 no kernel

G5_fail_closed.rule: require_measured_earth_orientation raises PredictedEarthOrientationError (a ValueError) naming the first predicted or uncovered epoch and its kernel, and returns silently when every epoch is measured; is_predicted_earth_orientation keeps 2027-03-08 True and 2025-03-01 False under the default profile

G6_selection_and_manifest.rule: explicit argument beats the environment variable, which beats the default; an unknown profile raises ValueError; every kernel of both profiles and both planetary ephemerides is in the manifest

G7_full_regression.rule: full regression green; the only pre-existing test changed is the readiness kernel count (10 -> 11), a deliberate contract change

reject_if: any G1 epoch differs (the default profile would change existing physics), or the provenance disagrees with the SPICE kernel actually used

results_slice_1.G7: PASS: full regression 2604 tests, 0 failures, 33 skipped (branch on origin/main 4d8819a); only the readiness kernel count changed (10 -> 11)
results_slice_1.diagnostic_note: PREDICT vs MEASURED station position in J2000; up to 2026-01-21 the MEASURED value is IERS-measured, so the PREDICT profile misplaces stations by up to ~20 m in that window. Self-consistent synthetic runs are unaffected; real data and external comparisons there need MEASURED.

scope_slice_2: Scenario wiring: ScenarioConfig.earth_orientation (None default = the process default, i.e. load_spice_kernels() exactly as before; 'predict' | 'measured' | 'measured_only'). The runner loads the selected profile; 'measured_only' loads MEASURED and fails closed (PredictedEarthOrientationError) before any propagation when the scenario span [et0, et0 + duration] holds predicted or uncovered orientation. The run provenance gains an earth_orientation block (resolved profile, policy, provenance at span start and end). The field is registered in SCENARIO_CONFIG_FIELDS_ADDED_AFTER_ARCHIVES (archives predating it ran with None) and enters scenario_measurement_identity when not None. Note fixed before results: the runner's epoch comes from fixtures/spice_snapshots.json (2027-03-02), beyond the high-precision kernel, so both profiles serve the predict kernel there; the measured-orientation effect is exercised by the slice-1 gates, not by a scenario run.
out_of_scope_slice_2: the LRO real-data study scripts (they furnish the high-precision kernel themselves; F5 must use earth_orientation='MEASURED' + require_measured_earth_orientation); a configurable scenario epoch; desktop form controls

G8_config_field.rule: default None; accepts predict/measured/measured_only, unknown raises ValueError; JSON round trip; schema lists it; SCENARIO_CONFIG_FIELDS_ADDED_AFTER_ARCHIVES['earth_orientation'] is None; scenario_measurement_identity carries it only when not None

G9_default_and_profiles_bitwise.rule: end-to-end runner (1 h, 600 s, seeded noise): unset, 'predict' and 'measured' give bitwise identical result columns at the fixture epoch (predict kernel serves 2027 under both profiles); the furnished kernel list of 'measured' has the high-precision kernel after the predict kernel

G10_measured_only_fails_closed.rule: 'measured_only' at the fixture epoch raises PredictedEarthOrientationError naming the predict kernel, before propagation

G11_run_provenance.rule: run provenance earth_orientation block: profile PREDICT (unset), MEASURED ('measured'); policy; span_start/span_end each with kernel earth_2025_250826_2125_predict.bpc, last_datum_utc 2025 AUG 26 00:00:00, measured false
